trigger.error_class: All officially documented Bybit V5 global and local-site API domains returned HTTP 403 from the GitHub-hosted runner.

permitted_probe.read_scope: CSV header, row count, source SHA-256, timestamp bounds, non-null counts and distinct-change counts for funding/index/mark/last fields. No strategy event, direction, return, PnL or candidate statistic.

prohibitions: No fit/development strategy PnL or candidate evaluation in the probe workflow.
No family, threshold, cost or survivor-gate decision from probe values.
A separate date-role and sparse-sample amendment is mandatory before any outcome-bearing screen.
